米.description: Short upper strokes and side strokes meet around a central vertical and crossing horizontal strokes. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

亮.description: A top cover sits above a central opening, with a lower roof-like form and 几-shaped base below. This describes placement, not historical origin.

先.description: The upper strokes sit above 土, with 儿-shaped strokes forming the lower part. The note describes visible placement without naming the unresolved upper subpart.

衣.description: A short top cover sits above the central crossing strokes, with long slanting strokes extending downward. This describes the visible layout only.

坐.description: Two 人-shaped sets of strokes meet above 土, forming one compact character. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

京.description: A top cover sits above a central 口-shaped form, with 小-shaped strokes below. This describes visible placement, not historical origin.

以.description: A narrow left-side form sits beside 人 on the right. The note describes placement only and does not assign a name or meaning to the unresolved left part.

可.description: The upper horizontal and vertical strokes join the lower 口-shaped strokes in one compact form. This describes the visible layout, not historical origin.

也.description: A short upper stroke leads into a curved lower stroke and rightward hook. The note describes the visible form without identifying an unresolved component.

为.description: Short dot strokes sit around a central curved and enclosed form. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.
